items.name: Record cards
items.summary: Select original records from a caller-owned grid or list window.

items.name: Ordered record chart
items.summary: Plot original authorized records without merging equal axis labels or reading another collection.

items.name: Record discussion
items.summary: Present original persisted comments and a caller-owned draft whose confirmation belongs to the host.

items.name: Confirmed record comparison
items.summary: Compare two to four complete original records with typed differences, stable identities and original field formatting.

items.name: Authorized event list
items.summary: Present ordered original business events with explicit time and severity tones.

items.name: Entity form
items.summary: Edit declared entity fields using their shared validators and editors.

items.name: Authorized task Gantt
items.summary: Present original ordered business intervals on an explicit fixed UTC range.

items.name: Original record journal
items.summary: Present original change IDs, schemas, actors and field changes in their supplied order with an explicit display window.

items.name: Authorized lifecycle board
items.summary: Select bounded records in their original lifecycle lanes and emit declared move commands.

items.name: Authorized record leaderboard
items.summary: Present original host-ranked Top-N records and emit their original identities.
